purpose.zh: 在晃动的吊环上练胸、手臂和肩胛骨的稳定
purpose.en: Build your chest, arms and shoulder-blade control on unsteady rings.

text.zh: 推起后再往下推一点，让上背微微拱起
text.en: After you press up, push a little further so your upper back rounds

text.zh: 吊环挂低，离地十几厘米，环贴在身体两侧。
text.en: Hang the rings low, about a hand span off the floor, close to your sides.

text.zh: 身体一条直线，慢慢下去。
text.en: Keep your body in one line and lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Letting the rings drift out to the sides.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时，下浅一点或换简单版
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, go less deep or use an easier version.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时马上停
cautions.en: Stop right away if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness.

changes: 改名：去掉术语「前伸」→ 吊环俯卧撑加推背（EN 不变）
节奏按 spec：下 1.2 s / 底 0.2 s / 推起 1.0 s + 推背 0.5 s = back 1.5 s / 顶端停 0.6 s + 放回 0.5 s = rest 1.1 s
口令顺序改成 下去 → 推起再推背（原 end「稳住」与动画顺序不符）；主口令只留一件事
flags: 改名：吊环俯卧撑加前伸 → 吊环俯卧撑加推背
批表取的是 scap 推背轨（go 0.4/hold 0.7），与俯卧撑整体节奏不符，按 spec 手算；推背后 0.6 s 停顿落在 rest 段、不念口令
